name: Teneo AI AB (publ)
summary: Headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, and established in 2011, Teneo AI AB (which rebranded from Artificial Solutions International AB in August 2024) delivers advanced, AI-driven automated voice communication solutions. Operating across Europe, the United States, and other international territories, the company utilizes its core Teneo platform. This versatile platform seamlessly integrates voice capabilities with digital channels, performs comprehensive data analysis, and orchestrates voice interactions, chat functionalities, and Large Language Models. Teneo AI's diverse product suite includes specialized tools like Teno.ai, the Teneo Accuracy Booster, solutions for both agentless and automated contact centers, conversational virtual reality applications, an LLM orchestrator, and dedicated Teneo Voice AI offerings. Furthermore, the company provides the Teneo Engine, a platform for generating API calls, and Teneo Data, an analytical tool designed to review user conversations and continuously enhance its conversational AI solutions.
